name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
summary: An accidental death and disability insurance scheme offering cover of Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death or total disability and Rs. 1 lakh for partial disability, for a nominal annual premium.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.
The applicant must be 70 years of age or younger.

entitlement_rules.text: Accidental death or total disability is covered up to Rs. 2 lakh.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the bank branch.
Escalation to the bank's scheme nodal officer.
Final grievance before the Insurance Ombudsman.
